title: 莱茵河水位11厘米：德国工业供应链承压，巴斯夫等巨头如何应对？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: This is a sort of a kind of obscure town here in Germany of cow, but it sits right kind of in the middle of the Rhine River, which is, of course, one of the most important waterways
segments.zh: 这是德国一个不太起眼的小镇，但它正好位于莱茵河的中段，而莱茵河是欧洲最重要的水道之一。

segments.en: within Europe, and particularly for German industry. It services all the southwest companies there of Germany and it attaches effectively the North Sea through the Netherlands, through
segments.zh: 对德国工业尤其重要，它为德国西南部的所有公司服务，实际上连接了北海，穿过荷兰、法国和德国，直达瑞士。

segments.en: France and Germany, and into Switzerland. And of course, there are canals that also connected to the Danube, which then flows towards the Black Sea. So one of the most important waterways
segments.zh: 当然，还有运河连接多瑙河，最终流向黑海。所以这是欧洲最重要的水道之一。

segments.en: here in Europe, and what we've got here in cow is the shallowice point between basically in the center of the Rhine River. And what we've been seeing are historic averages of all these
segments.zh: 我们现在在科布伦茨，这里是莱茵河中心地带的浅水点。我们看到的这些历史平均记录正在被打破。

segments.en: sort of records being broken. Of the shallowice level, we've reached here. You can see behind me there, this is the water gauging station tower there, which reads the number of centimeters
segments.zh: 浅水水位已经达到了这个水平。在我身后可以看到水位测量塔，它读取的是厘米数。

segments.en: of clearance that there is. It's reading at 11 right now. We should say that the former record was 25 centimeters. That was set back in 2018. And we are now hitting new records basically every day
segments.zh: 现在读数是11厘米。之前的记录是25厘米，那是在2018年。现在我们几乎每天都在刷新纪录。

segments.en: this week. We're now at 11. And the issue is Lizzie's that those records were made last time in 2018 back in October. We are now only in August. We may be at the very beginning of this. And what it will
segments.zh: 现在是11厘米。问题是，上次这些记录是在2018年10月创下的，而现在才8月，我们可能才刚刚开始。

segments.en: mean effectively, Lizzie, is that if these ships cannot cross this point, it effectively bisects the Rhine River. And that is going to cause a number of issues for a number of different companies,
segments.zh: 这意味着，如果船只无法通过这个点，实际上就切断了莱茵河。这将给许多不同的公司带来一系列问题。

segments.en: Tissin Crew, BASF, of course, Rhine, Mattel, named after the Rhine River itself are all companies that are situated across this river. We should also say that they'll have an impact on the German
segments.zh: 蒂森克虏伯、巴斯夫，当然还有莱茵金属，都是以莱茵河命名的，这些公司都分布在这条河沿岸。

segments.en: economy. We've heard some estimates were a little bit skeptical potentially of the estimates, because this is very hard to calculate. But we've heard from ING saying that this could cause
segments.zh: 我们还应该提到，这将对德国经济产生影响。我们听到了一些估计，可能对这些估计有些怀疑，因为这很难计算。但我们听到荷兰国际集团说，这可能导致……
